title: Is It Too Late to Buy Micron? | My Grok Bot Analysis
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez (with Grok bot)

macro_themes.view: Hot CPI tomorrow could knock semis lower; wait for the data before buying dips.
CXMT competition and the memory cyclical thesis explain Micron's low 12.5x multiple.
KOSPI (over half Samsung and SK Hynix) is down ~35% from highs, hurting leveraged traders.

calls.condition: Buy on a break above ~952 (momentum) or a dip to 903-918 with stop under 900; otherwise wait until after CPI
calls.reason: Bull case intact (record revenue, cheap 12.5x P/E) but five of six red days, CXMT fears and CPI risk; don't chase at 943.
calls.quote: Don't buy the dip here... The cleaner entries are a break back above $952 or a dip to 903 to 918

calls.reason: Retesting previous resistance range; a support break would gap lower into CPI.
calls.quote: If it ends up breaking the support, we have that gap down once again

notes: Date from 'Monday's close' plus 'CPI tomorrow, PPI Thursday' = Tue Oct 13. MU views come mostly from Ricky's Grok bot, which he endorses; 1,555 analyst average target and 1,100 prior high not recorded as his targets. 705 is the prior selloff low he warns about.
